normalization_audit.ordinary_inertia: eigenvalues in the archived normalized odd basis
normalization_audit.replay_independence: Primary and replay use the same implementation with materially different precision, quadrature step, orbit cutoff, spatial cutoff, and DE t-extent. This is a parameter replay, not an independent algorithm.

normalization_audit.tail_status: Primary/replay deliberately vary h cutoff, DE t-extent, orbit cutoff, step, and precision. Last-term diagnostics are stabilization evidence only; no new spatial-tail or orbit-tail certificate is claimed.

outcome.conclusion: No archived-prefix counterexample to n_-(M0)<=1 was found by this floating cutoff diagnostic. This finite observation does not establish M0>=0 or any all-degree inertia bound.
